# CreditDecide

> CreditDecide is a no-code, AI-native underwriting operating system for lenders and fintechs. Build lending policies visually, collect borrower applications via white-label forms with KYC, connect live credit bureau and open banking data, and let AI produce evidence-backed APPROVE / REVIEW / DECLINE decisions across six markets — without writing code.

CreditDecide is the underwriting operating system for modern lenders. It replaces manual document review and hand-written credit memos with a continuous, no-code workspace: configure your lending policy in a visual rule builder, intake applications through branded white-label forms with market-specific KYC, connect live credit bureau and open banking data (or upload documents), and receive an explainable decision with full evidence lineage. The AI underwriter advises; your policy decides.

## What you can do without code

- Build lending policies visually: add rules, set thresholds, and define APPROVE / REVIEW / DECLINE outcomes. Policies are versioned — an active version is never silently overwritten.
- Collect borrower applications through white-label intake forms with market-specific KYC and verification.
- Connect live credit bureau and open banking data sources per market, or upload documents. Either path works.
- Normalize financial and credit data into canonical, provider-independent profiles.
- Generate structured risk signals across five dimensions: credit, affordability, fraud, data quality, and policy.
- Get an AI underwriter recommendation with an in-context assistant. The AI advises; your policy stays authoritative.
- Trace every risk signal back to its source field through an evidence graph.
- Export decisions as PDF, CSV, or Word with a full audit trail.
- Operate in isolated sandbox and production environments (uw_test_ and uw_live_ API keys).
- Monitor post-decision loan outcomes and feed calibration back into your models.

## Markets served

United Kingdom, United States, Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa. Each market resolves its own currency, regulatory profile, credit bureau, and open banking provider defaults.

## Pricing

Free sandbox with synthetic data and 1,000 trial credits. Paid plans (Starter, Growth, Scale) plus usage-based credit packs for production. See https://oldme.base44.app/pricing.
